initial_evidence: All arms begin with the exact benchmark observation already available at the auditor/consumer. No observation-refresh process; stale cases remain stale. Conditional on initial receipt, not full V2X exchange.
route: Map each case road to A; choose main if observed open, detour if closed; structured claimed_closed equals evidence. Prose contradictions are not silently parsed into structured fields. No vehicle controls executed.
timing: Imposed service times0.5/1/2/3/5/8s with cached verdicts, no extra inference. Synthetic controlled sensitivity, not measured latency or traffic outcomes. Deadline emits returned verdict before2s or template at2s on pending/failure; content withholds at5s if incomplete. This is simulated timer replay, not a new live asynchronous experiment.
transport: Every arm uses first native TX at/after message ready. One packet, no retries, receive delay/loss preserved. Baselines transmit at0 readiness; content/timeout at their readiness. Hard5s application deadline and evidence expiry rechecked at delivery. Native offered load is a replay abstraction, not generated network performance.
alignment: Request trace epoch 10+6*world+wording seconds (absolute in stored trace); same for all categories/models/policies. Isolated case replay, not simultaneous load. No looping/resampling.
scope: Two reused stationary LTE traces, no city coupling, no urban/5G/6G validation. No independent packet/model/case population inference.
additional_policy: audit_fallback: original text only on accept before2s, otherwise verified template on reject/unsure/error/timeout; same runtime gates. Action admissions only, no traffic execution.
